rationale: The source requires Mica m07 to be a tolerated control under the same 10-unit intravenous liquid exposure as Rowan m07. The candidate changes Mica's route and form to oral capsule, so the represented comparison no longer holds those high-information exposure qualifiers constant. That can invalidate the tolerated-control contrast needed to test whether Quartz itself discriminates the outcome and therefore can change whether the conclusion that Quartz survives the represented comparison is permitted.
